title: Resorts World — Short Asian Getaway
overview_paragraphs: For travelers who want a proper holiday feel without committing a full week, this short cruise out of Singapore packs in casino floors, multiple pool decks, and a full entertainment lineup into a long weekend at sea. It's the easiest way to add a genuine cruise experience onto the front or back of a longer Southeast Asia trip.
Good for couples, families, or groups wanting an easy, low-effort short escape with everything included onboard.

itinerary.title: Embarkation — Singapore
itinerary.desc: Board your ship from Singapore's Marina Bay Cruise Centre in the afternoon, with an evening sail-away party on the pool deck.

itinerary.title: Day at Sea
itinerary.desc: A full day to enjoy the ship's pools, spa, casino, and onboard entertainment shows.

itinerary.title: Port Call
itinerary.desc: A short stop at a nearby port (Malaysia or international waters cruise, depending on sailing schedule) for a few hours ashore or onboard relaxation.

itinerary.title: Disembarkation
itinerary.desc: Return to Singapore in the morning and disembark for your onward journey.
